user.title: Recipes
user.description: Recipes are read with an AI Task entity. Short social media captions are completed with a speech-to-text transcript of the video.

data.transcribe: Transcribe video audio when the caption is short
data.notify_service: Notify when a recipe is ready (notify entity like notify.barts_iphone, or a notify action)
data.auto_discounts: Refresh the weekly supermarket offers automatically

data.transcribe: Transcribe video audio when the caption is short
data.notify_service: Notify when a recipe is ready (notify entity like notify.barts_iphone, or a notify action)
data.auto_discounts: Refresh the weekly supermarket offers automatically

add.name: Add recipe
add.description: Save a recipe from a URL (web page, TikTok, Instagram).

url.name: URL
url.description: Link to the recipe or video.

force.name: Force
force.description: Save again even if this link was saved before.

status.name: Status
status.description: List recent recipes and their processing status.

id.name: Recipe ID
id.description: Return details of one recipe instead of the list.

delete.name: Delete recipe
delete.description: Delete a recipe and its media.

retry.name: Retry
retry.description: Process a recipe again; without an ID all failed recipes are retried.

set_discounts.name: Set discounts
set_discounts.description: Replace one supermarket's discount list for a week; the other supermarkets are not touched. Items match recipe ingredients by their terms (Dutch and English keywords, all words of one term must appear in the ingredient name).

items.name: Items
items.description: List of {name, terms, price, was, note, valid_from, valid_to}. Only name is required (terms default to the name; an item may have its own period).

refresh_discounts.name: Refresh discounts
refresh_discounts.description: Fetch this week's offers from Albert Heijn, Jumbo, Lidl and Dirk (only the lists that are missing, ended or older than 5 days, unless forced). Returns a report per supermarket.

store.name: Supermarkets
store.description: Only these (ah, jumbo, lidl, dirk). Default: all.

force.name: Force
force.description: Fetch again even when the list is still fresh.

test_base.name: Test base URL
test_base.description: Development only: a local URL (127.0.0.1 or localhost) with fixture pages instead of the real shops.
